faqs.q: Why should I edit PDF metadata?
faqs.a: Editing PDF metadata ensures your name and copyright are properly credited as the author, gives documents professional titles for clients or academic submissions, and removes unwanted software traces.

faqs.q: Does this tool upload my documents to any server?
faqs.a: No. Everything runs 100% locally in your web browser using client-side JavaScript. Your confidential files never leave your device.

faqs.q: Can I remove AI generator metadata with this tool?
faqs.a: Yes. The editor includes an automatic option to purge hidden C2PA manifests and XMP provenance streams generated by automated AI tools.
You can apply 1-click official software profiles including Microsoft Word 365, Adobe Acrobat Reader DC, Apple Pages, and Google Docs.

faqs.q: Is this PDF metadata editor free?
faqs.a: Yes, it is 100% free with unlimited usage, zero watermarks, and no registration required.
